hubSottotitolo: Operations area: class registers, timetable and student-file access log. Configuration (subjects, teachers, objectives, judgements, term assessment) is in Settings → Primary teaching.
registriSottotitolo: Access everything a teacher does (register, grades, lessons, attendance, notes, term assessment) for any class, in edit mode.
registriAppelloDesc: Attendance, late arrivals, early departures, justifications
orarioAttivo: Active: {modello}h / {giorni, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
orarioImpostaTempo: Set the school time to generate the grid.
orarioModificaHint: Edit the times and type of each period, add a break/lunch or delete a slot. Warning: regenerating from the school time overwrites these changes.
fascicoloSottotitolo: Immutable log of access to confidential documents (IEP/PDP/health).
didatticaNessunaClasseTesto: Subjects are managed per class: first create a Primary section in Roster → Sections, then come back here to apply the subject preset or add them manually.
classificazioneSottotitolo: Set which levels each teacher is enabled for. The visible functions (register/grades vs diary) depend on this classification and on the function matrix.
docentiMaterieNessunClassificato: No teacher classified as «primary». Set it in the Teacher classification tab.
materieNessunObiettivoDefinito: No objective defined for {codice} at year {livello} (Objectives section).
materieNessunaMateria: No subject. Apply a preset or add one.
obiettiviPlaceholderDescrizione: E.g. Reads and understands various types of text
giudiziScalaSottotitolo: Used ongoing and at term assessment. Preset with the 6 official judgements (Annex A). The numeric value feeds the ongoing average; the descriptive judgement is applied automatically in the report card.
giudiziErroreOperazione: The operation failed. Please try again.
giudiziTemplateSottotitolo: Composable fragments by dimension/value. Editing them overrides the default for your school.
impostazioniSottotitolo: Register editing windows and grade-notification send buffer. Enabling modules per level is managed in Settings → Functions & modules.
scrutinioGiudiziSottotitolo: For each class level, subject and period, define the text associated with each mark. In the report card it is applied automatically to the assigned mark. Filling in a level (e.g. Year 1) applies to all sections of that level.
scrutinioGiudiziConfiguraPeriodo: First configure a term assessment period (Term assessment tab).
scrutinioGiudiziConfiguraScala: First configure the judgement scale (Judgements tab).
scrutinioGiudiziNessunaMateria: No coded subject for year {livello}. Configure the subjects (Subjects tab).
periodiSottotitolo: Define the periods (e.g. 1st term, Final assessment). Teachers will select them in the Term assessment section.
periodiConfermaElimina: Delete the period? Linked assessments will also be removed.
